trigger_mode.description: How an eligible character event starts: once at the beginning of a workday, immediately on entering its location, at a preoperative stage, or through the Sunday schedule.

related_effects.description: Optional relationship changes for supporting characters participating in the same event choice.

speaker_label.description: Optional display name for a supporting speaker while the event remains owned by its primary actor.

portrait_scale.description: Multiplier applied after the default event-portrait fit. Use it to normalize subject size when transparent canvases contain different framing.

portrait_right.description: Logical-canvas x coordinate used as the portrait texture's right edge.

portrait_y.description: Logical-canvas y coordinate for the top of the portrait texture.

hide_portrait.description: Suppress character art for narration that occurs before the actor becomes visible.

allow_dialogue_scroll.description: Exceptional opt-in for intentionally scrollable transcripts or system summaries. Ordinary VN dialogue must fit one dialogue page.

days_after_required_events.description: Minimum full day gap after every required character event completes.

special_requirements.description: Implemented character-event gates. Unknown requirement types remain locked.

chain_followup.description: Marks a rank-granting epilogue inside an already-started relationship chain. Its required-event delay is exact and does not inherit the inter-milestone cooldown.

preop_stage_id.description: When present, this event auto-starts on entering the named preoperative stage and is excluded from ordinary location entry triggers.

preop_required_flags.description: Optional preoperative flags that must already be present before a stage-triggered event can start.

mandatory.description: Auto-start this short event from the map when its conditions are met.

consumes_sunday.description: Completing this event uses the current Sunday activity slot.

rank_up_required_flags.description: All listed relationship flags must exist before a bond/rank event grants its level.

retry_if_flags.description: A completed event remains available when all listed relationship flags exist.

intraoperative_avatar.description: Machine-readable production checklist for the compact staff head-and-shoulders avatar used beneath the operative-field HUD.

background_id.description: Optional per-node background override for a single-day event that moves between locations.

allow_dialogue_scroll.description: Exceptional opt-in for intentionally scrollable transcripts or system summaries. Ordinary VN dialogue must fit one dialogue page.

requirements.description: When unmet in normal play, the node is skipped to fallback_next. Gallery replay retains the complete authored branch.

acceptance_chance_by_level.description: Optional deterministic Sunday invitation acceptance percentage overrides keyed by relationship level.

cg_dialogue_delay_seconds.description: Seconds a newly displayed CG remains unobstructed before its dialogue and controls appear.

auto_schedule.description: Automatically starts once its configured trigger mode is reached and the event is due.

trigger_mode.description: day_start starts during workday scheduling; location starts when the player enters location_id.

announcement.description: Short scheduling notice shown before an automatically scheduled event begins.

completion_hint.description: Optional player-facing guidance shown after completion, such as the location and delay for the next relationship event.

relationship_rewards.description: Relationship levels granted when the special event completes.

allow_level_skip.description: Temporary testing escape hatch; remove when the authored prior-rank gate is restored.

award_event_familiarity.description: Awards the centrally configured familiarity amount for the target relationship level.

trigger_day.description: Preferred first day. If blocked by a higher-priority event, the event remains due and is retried on later days.

trigger_date.description: Fixed Gregorian trigger date in the 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31 game year.

final_week_allowed.description: Only explicitly marked story/ending events may occupy days 359-365.

sunday_start_allowed.description: Explicit opt-in for fixed festivals, mandatory events or major cases that may begin on Sunday. Ongoing multi-day events do not need this flag to span Sunday.
